title: Training Notes on the Returning-Plan Credit for Patient Payment Plans Installments
content:
Patient Services Center training notes on the credit the signed installment of a Patient Payment Plans agreement carries for a patient's earlier plans with Linden Ridge Medical Group.

**Q. What is the returning-plan credit?**
A. The returning-plan credit on the signed installment is 4.00 when the patient's Patient Financial Account shows at least 12 payments posted with the payment method "payment plan", 2.00 when it shows at least one but fewer than 12, and 0.00 when it shows none.

**Q. How is it applied?**
A. The credit, in dollars, is subtracted from the monthly installment worked out for the agreement before any credit. The signed installment is never below the tier's minimum installment and is rounded half up to the cent.

**Q. Which payments are counted?**
A. Every payment on the Patient Financial Account posted with the payment method "payment plan", over the account's history.

| Payments posted with the method "payment plan" | Returning-plan credit |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 4.00 |
| 1 to 11 | 2.00 |
| None | 0.00 |

**Q. What do the edges look like? (hypothetical)**
A. An account showing exactly 12 such payments earns 4.00; one showing 11 earns 2.00; one showing a single such payment earns 2.00; one showing none earns 0.00. On an installment of 118.00 before credit, a credit of 4.00 gives 114.00.
